index_calculation: DJI Mavic 3M reflectance (black level, vignetting, gain x exposure, SensorGainAdjustment, sunlight-sensor Irradiance); per-pixel NDVI/NDRE sampled every 1 cm; plant pixels = NDVI > plant_ndvi_min on the plastic beds; values corrected for position in the photo and referred to the photo centre (tile_stress.py --position-correction auto)
note: Your original DAP-40 profile (original/tomato_dap40_original.json) with NDVI cuts unchanged. NDRE cuts are on THIS script's scale. Calibrated on the full Kiran Mahale farm (1,561 tiles, 13 Aug + 11 Oct): after the photo-position correction, plant NDRE = 0.21 x plant NDVI on both dates (seedlings and canopy alike), while the original DAP-40 profile pairs NDRE = 0.52 x NDVI (0.32 with 0.60) - a different NDRE calculation. The original NDRE cuts were therefore multiplied by 0.40 (0.28 -> 0.112, 0.32 -> 0.128). Not checked against plants in the field.
